nodes.label: Kiosk Mode Layers
nodes.rationale: Web layer re-enters fullscreen, blocks exit gestures, and traps history back with a 3s caregiver exit hold; Android shell adds immersive sticky bars, consumes hardware back, and uses lock task when provisioned as device owner.

nodes.label: Charging Aware Idle Dim
nodes.rationale: navigator.getBattery returns stale state inside the WebView so the board dimmed on the charger; NativeBridge.isCharging reads the battery broadcast with a 5s poll fallback, overlay opacity is derived so dim state survives charger connects, and the 2026-10-04 change dims to 60 percent brightness instead of near-black.

nodes.label: On Device Verification
nodes.rationale: Debug WebView remote debugging over adb forward is the only way to assert in-page state; long idle timers are collapsed via injected script and charging is simulated with dumpsys battery.
